integrity: The underlying literature is cited without reproducing third-party papers. The optimum proof and its standalone checker are included. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification is restricted to finite linear powers of positive weighted distinct-letter permutation templates; it neither counts embeddings nor covers templates repeating a letter in separated runs. Finite tests do not certify the infinite theorem; proof is mathematical. An unindexed equivalent may exist.
title: Complete longest-run-subsequence classification for weighted permutation powers
